findings.observedFacts: All three new AI reports record geometry issues. findings.title: Restore durable continuity of diagnostic findings
findings.observedFacts: The findings register was an empty array. The saved completed review result referenced D-0003 and D-0004, and conversation history also recorded D-0001 and D-0002. findings.recommendation: Recover the prior findings from verified review history and choose persistent storage for sanitized findings that survives checkout changes. Add a review-start consistency check against the prior result before future tooling advances the cursor. Do not restore private raw snapshots.

findings.title: Explain partial outcomes when all recorded issues are resolved
findings.observedFacts: One of three new AI reports, protocol0.0.29 for five requested labels, reports partial while every attempted stage passed and every recorded issue is resolved. It lists16 generation and16 proof attempts. The website accepted the delivered pack. No delivered-label count or process note explains the partial outcome.
findings.hypothesis: One or more labels may have been omitted without retaining their failure in the final feedback, or the partial outcome may have remained stale after successful repair. Neither can be determined from this report.
findings.recommendation: Inspect or reproduce partial-pack completion using current0.0.29. Keep original request count and unresolved omitted-label issues as instructed. Consider bounded delivered/omitted counts only if the gap repeats; do not infer completion from resolved issue flags alone.
reproductionSteps: Run a controlled five-label request with one omitted label and verify partial feedback retains its unresolved issue.
Complete a later repair and verify final outcome and issue flags reflect actual delivery.
Compare requested and delivered counts locally without uploading images or raw manifests.
findings.expectedMeasure: Every partial report has an observable explanation such as unresolved omitted-label issues or bounded delivery counts. Preserve successful recovery without inventing failure details.
